paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from Markarian 421
suggested_experiment_name: Markarian 421 TeV gamma-ray observations (Fermi-LAT and HAWC)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports a 99% C.L. upper limit on axion-photon coupling from TeV gamma-ray observations of the blazar Markarian 421 using 1038 days of data from Fermi-LAT and HAWC (2015 June to 2018 July). The main result is g_agamma ≲ 4.0×10^-12 GeV^-1 for axion mass range [1.0×10^-9 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 1.0×10^-8 eV]. This is claimed to be the most stringent limit in this mass region. The limit is mass-dependent within the stated range, encoded as a horizontal line at the coupling value spanning the mass interval.
